title: Lock & Shop Rate Hold: Availability and Fee Schedule by Pre-Approval Level
content:
A Lock & Shop rate hold holds an interest rate under a Mortgage Pre-Approval. Whether a level offers it, its length, its fee, how the fee is disposed of and whether the held rate may float down are set per level.

## Schedule 1: availability, length and fee

| Level | Lock & Shop rate hold offered | Calendar days of the hold from the hold date | Fee for the rate hold (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | No | 0 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | Yes | 90 | 595.00 |

The hold length is 0 days and the fee USD 0.00 where no hold is offered.

## Schedule 2: fee disposition and float-down

| Level | Fee credited at closing when the loan closes under the held rate | Fee refunded when Larkspur declines the application | Fee forfeited when the hold expires without an application | Held rate may be lowered once if the market improves | Rate improvement needed for the one-time float-down (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | No | No | No | No | 0.250 |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | No | No | No | No | 0.250 |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | No | No | No | No | 0.250 |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | No | No | No | No | 0.250 |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | No | No | No | No | 0.250 |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 0.250 |

## Column definitions

- **Offered**: whether a Lock & Shop rate hold is offered.
- **Hold length**: the calendar days of the rate hold from the hold date (0 where none).
- **Fee**: the fee for the rate hold, in US dollars (0.00 where none).
- **Credited at closing**: whether the hold fee is credited at closing when the loan closes under the held rate.
- **Refunded if declined**: whether the hold fee is refunded when Larkspur declines the application.
- **Forfeited if unused**: whether the hold fee is forfeited when the hold expires without an application.
- **Float-down allowed**: whether a held rate may be lowered once if the market improves.
- **Float-down improvement**: the rate improvement needed for the one-time hold float-down, in percent to three decimals.

## Summary of the schedule

The Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval is the only level that offers a rate hold: 90 calendar days for a fee of USD 595.00, with the fee credited at closing, refunded on a Larkspur decline or forfeited if unused as described above, and a one-time float-down when the rate improves by 0.250 percentage points. The other five levels offer no hold, and their fee disposition and float-down columns do not come into play.
